user.title: Regionalwerke Baden — Login
user.description: Works for both MFA and non-MFA accounts. If your Regionalwerke Baden portal has MFA (2FA) enabled, you can optionally paste your TOTP secret here to avoid entering a code on every re-login (~30 days). Leave it empty and you'll be asked for a 6-digit code on the next step.

data_description.totp_secret: Base32 string or otpauth:// URI from your authenticator app. Stored in Home Assistant only.

mfa.title: Two-factor code
mfa.description: Your account requires a 6-digit code. Enter it from your authenticator app, or use a backup code. You can also paste your TOTP secret to enable fully automatic future logins.

data.totp_secret: TOTP secret (optional, stored for next time)

data_description.code: The 6-digit code currently shown by your authenticator app.
data_description.totp_secret: Base32 string or otpauth:// URI. With this stored, no code is ever needed again.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Regionalwerke Baden
reauth_confirm.description: The portal session has expired. Enter the current 6-digit code, or paste your TOTP secret to enable automatic future logins. Your saved email and password will be used.

data_description.code: The 6-digit code currently shown by your authenticator app.
data_description.totp_secret: Base32 string or otpauth:// URI. This replaces any previously saved secret.

reauth_password.title: Update password
reauth_password.description: The saved credentials were rejected. Enter the current password for this account, then continue with two-factor authentication.

error.choose_one_auth_method: Enter either the current two-factor code or a TOTP secret, not both
error.code_or_secret_required: Enter a two-factor code or TOTP secret
error.invalid_code: The current two-factor code was rejected
error.invalid_totp: The TOTP secret is invalid or generated a code the portal rejected

abort.wrong_account: This is a different account. Re-authenticate with the account this entry was set up with.

init.title: Regionalwerke Baden options
init.description:
Store or clear a TOTP secret for automatic two-factor login, and optionally track what your energy costs.

Cost tracking reads Regionalwerke Baden's published tariff file (the machine-readable document every Swiss grid operator must publish) and writes a matching cost statistic you can select as "Use a statistic" under Grid consumption. The tariff names must match that file exactly — if one does not, the log lists the available names.

data_description.totp_secret: Base32 string or otpauth:// URI. This overrides any secret saved when the integration was added.
data_description.cost_enabled: Writes a cost statistic next to each consumption statistic. Return to grid is not priced — feed-in compensation is not in the tariff file.
data_description.cost_product: Your contracted product, e.g. primastrom (standard) or einfachstrom.
data_description.cost_grid_tariff: Your grid usage tariff. OL7 is the household one (up to 50'000 kWh per year).
data_description.cost_municipality: Used to pick the right concession fee, e.g. Baden or Ennetbaden.
data_description.cost_surcharge: Netzzuschlag plus Förderabgabe, which are charged per kWh but are not in the tariff file. Fixed monthly base and metering fees are never included; add your share here if you want your bill total instead of the cost per kWh.
